name: Management Plan Replacement V 14
definition: The ManagementPlanReplacement message is sent by a terminal manager to a POI to set maintenance actions to be performed.

Header.name: Header
Header.definition: Set of characteristics related to the transfer of the management plan.

ManagementPlan.name: Management Plan
ManagementPlan.definition: Sequence of terminal maintenance actions to be performed by a point of interaction (POI).

SecurityTrailer.name: Security Trailer
SecurityTrailer.definition: Trailer of the message containing a MAC or a digital signature.
